selected_evidence.requirement: Baseline state before hardening (ICMP redirects/source route not disabled)
selected_evidence.summary: Pre-change sysctl showed accept_redirects=1 (all/default) and accept_source_route=1 (default), confirming the insecure baseline.

selected_evidence.requirement: Persistent config file created for IPv4 redirect/source-route hardening
selected_evidence.summary: Wrote /etc/sysctl.d/60-disable-icmp-redirects-source-route.conf setting accept_redirects, secure_redirects, accept_source_route to 0 for all and default.

selected_evidence.requirement: Settings applied live and confirmed at all/default level
selected_evidence.summary: sudo sysctl --system output shows the new file's directives loaded with value 0.

selected_evidence.requirement: Settings confirmed on all live interfaces including existing ones
selected_evidence.summary: Per-interface /proc/sys checks showed enp1s0/lo initially retained old values (1), then were explicitly set and verified to 0 across all/default/enp1s0/lo for accept_redirects, secure_redirects, and accept_source_route.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: healthy baseline before restart
selected_evidence.summary: Captured pre-restart boot_id (92ec88af-041e-4dc3-b2b9-800263b2b2cb) and systemctl is-system-running=running as the healthy baseline.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
selected_evidence.summary: Issued a backgrounded systemctl reboot with a short delay; the exec call returned its acknowledgement (reboot issued, pid 1311) before the node went down.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: proof node was actually down / mid-restart
selected_evidence.summary: A poll during the restart window returned a connection timeout, showing the node was genuinely unreachable mid-reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: changed boot identity proving a real restart
selected_evidence.summary: Boot ID read 92ec88af-041e-4dc3-b2b9-800263b2b2cb before, then 401d8a7d-2cae-4ee6-ac1e-1a146f5b41aa once connectivity returned, proving the kernel actually restarted.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: post-restart recovery and persistence of the hardening settings
selected_evidence.summary: Post-reboot check shows systemctl is-system-running=running and, without any manual re-application, enp1s0/all/default all read accept_redirects=0, secure_redirects=0, accept_source_route=0, matching the persistent /etc/sysctl.d file content shown in the same command — proving the hardening survives reboot.
